title: Ohu nke Amamihe Zoro Ezo
intro: N'ime nnukwu akụkọ Quran, e nwere otu onye dị mgbagwoju anya, onye na-ejere Allah ozi nke nwere ihe ọmụma na ebere Chineke. Onye a dị omimi gafere ụzọ ya na otu n'ime ndị amụma kachasị ukwuu, wee ruo n'ụzọ jupụtara n'ihe ndị na-agbagwoju anya nke na-ama aka n'ókè nghọta mmadụ. Ihe omume ọ bụla, ọ bụ ezie na o yiri ka ọ bụ ihe na-ezighị ezi, zoro ihe mmụta dị omimi gbasara akara aka, ndidi, na amamihe a na-adịghị ahụ anya dị n'azụ iwu Chineke. Ònye bụ onye a na-adịghị ahụ anya, oleekwa eziokwu ha kpughere?
clues: Abụ m ohu Allah, a họpụtara m maka ihe ọmụma na ebere pụrụ iche.
Onye amụma ukwu chọrọ ịmụta ihe n'aka m, ekwetakwara m n'okpuru ọnọdụ siri ike.
N'oge nzukọ anyị, emere m ihe atọ yiri ka ọ bụ ihe na-ezighị ezi nye onye mụ na ya so.
Emebiri m ụgbọ mmiri nke ndị ogbenye, mana ọ bụ ebere zoro ezo.
Egburu m otu nwatakịrị nwoke, ọ bụ ezie na o yiri ka ọ dị njọ, ọ bụ iji chebe ndị mụrụ ya ka ha ghara iru újú.
Ewughachiri m mgbidi n'obodo nke na-anaghị anabata anyị, na-ekpughe akụ̀ dị n'okpuru ya.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
